platform: Apple M4 Max, macOS 26.6.2, arm64 release
method: Fresh application process. Search loaded commits for 1e11554, select it, and open the starting file. Then 20 Down and 20 Up in the focused file list, observing native AX after each action. Starts and ends on the same file. Initial file open is excluded from the traversal statistics.
boundary: Application file-selection handler through generation/mode-checked GPUI frame callback after the preview is prepared. Excludes pre-handler input delivery, OS presentation and completed GPU execution.
cache: Fresh application preview cache. Filesystem caches were not flushed. Return traversal can hit the 32-entry cache; editors are reconstructed lazily when changing files. Other desktop applications and development activity remained running.
limits: Small local confirmation run, not a cold-disk or comparative benchmark, performance improvement claim, latency/memory guarantee, or image decode benchmark.
